google_play.health_apps_declaration: Nutrition, activity, weight and wellness tracking; no diagnosis, treatment, prevention, or emergency use.

health_connect.purpose: User-requested import/export of supported weight, steps, activity, workout and energy records.

permissions_justification.camera: Barcode scanning and user-invoked meal-photo capture only.
permissions_justification.notifications: Opt-in reminders and non-sensitive status messaging.
permissions_justification.bluetooth: Explicitly initiated supported BIL device discovery and connection.

google_play.app_access: Core local logging works without an account. Cloud community, AI gateways, purchases, push, and hardware remain unavailable unless production configuration and permissions exist.

app_privacy.account_and_user_content: Linked to user when cloud account features are enabled.
app_privacy.health_and_fitness: Used for app functionality and analytics visible to the user; not advertising.
app_privacy.purchases: Used to verify entitlement and restore purchases.

apple_app_store.healthkit_explanation: BIL reads and writes only user-selected supported wellness records. HealthKit data is never used for advertising and does not constitute medical diagnosis.
apple_app_store.ble_explanation: BLE access is used only after explicit user action to discover and connect supported BIL hardware. Physical-device success is not claimed without testing.
apple_app_store.ai_photo_explanation: Meal images are sent only after user action to a configured server gateway. Results are candidates with confidence and require review; nutrition is never invented.
apple_app_store.restore_purchases: Available from the plans screen and verified against the store and server entitlement boundary.
apple_app_store.terms_and_privacy_placement: Visible from Settings and the paywall; public HTTPS URLs remain owner input until published.
apple_app_store.encryption_usage: Standard TLS, OS key storage, and store SDK transport; no proprietary cryptography claimed.
apple_app_store.iap_review_screenshot_plan: Use the real unconfigured/configured paywall capture after App Store products exist; never submit a fabricated purchase success.

subscription_copy.tax_note: Prices and applicable taxes are determined by the store for the user's country. BIL does not calculate or deduct store tax locally.
